task: D9.14 Market observation page uses the Manager API as the only business read and fails closed without legacy fallback
decision: The market observation GET route is manager-owned. CandidateExchangeSnapshot now includes bounded token metadata for anchors, YZ endpoints and intermediate-pool tokens, and Flask maps the manager snapshot to the existing page DTO without legacy bootstrap, observation payload, static metadata or cache. The page no longer emits closedLoopSequences or closedLoopRoutes; those arrays are empty and closed-loop consumption remains owned by the M5 closed-loop page. When the manager response is unavailable, malformed, or scoped to another chain, Flask returns 503 manager_read_failed with dataSource=manager and no legacy fallback.
changes: CandidateExchangeSnapshot gains a bounded tokens array read from token_library_catalog for only the current observation scope endpoints and intermediate-pool tokens
/api/dex/market-observation GET calls market_observation_manager_page_payload unconditionally and no longer invokes legacy bootstrap, observation payload, static metadata, cache or manager shadow
Flask maps yzPairs, pools, abnormal rows, liquidity snapshots and tokens into the existing candidateObservationGroups, bridgePoolObservationGroups, associated pairs/pools/tokens and pagination DTO
Market observation no longer claims closed-loop output; closedLoopSequences and closedLoopRoutes are empty arrays on the manager-only DTO
summary.usdDepthRequired=false; YZ and candidate pool admission does not require USD depth or USD TVL
Manager response errors, missing arrays, invalid token metadata and chain scope mismatch return 503 manager_read_failed with dataSource=manager; no legacy fallback
POST /api/dex/market-observation/refresh remains a legacy maintenance entry until M4 production builder/apply authority is switched; the GET read path is already manager-owned
Architecture and workflow tests lock the market observation GET authority boundary and manager DTO contract
